selection_rules.rlpd_best_carry: argmax disp_m among frozen-carry-classified conditions, RLPD@415140 n=50 det
selection_rules.rlpd_throw_exploit: argmax lift/disp ratio among frozen-throw-classified conditions
selection_rules.median_return: median return condition (both arms grasp-only) -- the typical case
selection_rules.matched_disagreement: all conditions where the frozen label differs between RLPD@415140 and SAC_s2@414000 at matched budget
selection_rules.progression: a matched-disagreement carry condition, rendered at every retained RLPD checkpoint

caveat_carry_quality.note: every RLPD carry lifts BELOW the weakest demonstration; must be checked visually before being called transport
